Name: Romanceable Wizard Portrait
Author: lllllttt
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
This mod is based on the portrait created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romantic Rasmodius[/url] and the original version If you haven't installed Romanceable Rasmodius, you can choose the original portrait.

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list=1]
1.Download modules and pre installed components.2.Open Portrait/Portraits and create a new folder inside to place the portrait that needs to be replaced.3.Start the game and switch portraits by pressing "P" in the character dialog box.[/list]
[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[b]- [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
[b]- [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]

It is recommended to use it together with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romantic Rasmodius[/url] character extension mod for a complete experience.

Manifest.Name: Romanceable Wizard Portrait
Manifest.Description: Portrait beautification based on Romanceable Rasmodius, including original Wizard beautification.
Manifest.Author: Lott
